PERMITTED_INTERPRETATIONS.rule: exactly these four readings, decided by the D1A+D1B results, not chosen after seeing them
PERMITTED_INTERPRETATIONS.1_localized_off_support: Phase 0 barely contained flag-stolen states AND excluding them makes Q_psi look substantially stronger -> localized surrogate off-support + broader optimization interference
PERMITTED_INTERPRETATIONS.2_capacity_or_representation_failure: flag-stolen states were well represented but Q_psi is still confidently inverted there -> scorer target/capacity/representation failure in that regime, not a coverage problem
PERMITTED_INTERPRETATIONS.3_diffuse_interference: removing flag-stolen states barely changes the aggregate -> the interference problem is more diffuse than D0 currently suggests
PERMITTED_INTERPRETATIONS.4_unresolved: if the uncertainty remains broad -> record UNRESOLVED
prohibited: declaring a successor method design from D1 alone
treating D1B as independent confirmation of the own_flag_stolen finding
any threshold invented after seeing the D1A proportions
